assumptions.statement: The damping coefficient is a route-leak rate over unresolved ledger shell inventory, not a propagation rate over writable capacity.
The unresolved damping shell is L - V, where L is the closed ledger and V is the committed write cell.
assumptions.tested_by: exact identities L - V = R^2 - d_hat^2 = 135

assumptions.statement: The numerator is R because damping is route-resolved leak-back rather than d_hat-dimensional propagation.
assumptions.tested_by: wrong-numerator controls d_hat/(L - V) and Theta/(L - V)

assumptions.statement: The Berti 2009 value is an external comparator only and is not used to construct or tune the formula.
assumptions.tested_by: runner uses no search and no comparator-derived coefficient

assumptions.statement: No arbitrary fitted constant is permitted. The only constants are sealed SAM atoms and the external comparator.

missing_physics: full substrate equation of motion for carrier-tensor perturbations
complete damping operator for arbitrary substrate modes
